global_character_rules.art_style: Original premium cinematic Indian mythology-inspired anime
global_character_rules.rule_1: Recurring characters must keep the same facial structure, hairstyle, skin tone, eye color, age appearance and body proportions across all episodes.
global_character_rules.rule_2: Default clothing remains consistent unless the screenplay explicitly requires a costume change.
global_character_rules.rule_3: Never redesign a character automatically between scenes.
global_character_rules.rule_4: Battle damage, dirt, rain and temporary injuries may change, but permanent physical identity must remain unchanged.
global_character_rules.rule_5: Do not imitate the exact visual style or character design of any existing anime franchise.
global_character_rules.rule_6: Every recurring character should eventually use an approved reference image as the primary visual reference.

physical_design.build: Athletic, lean and realistic rather than extremely muscular
physical_design.face: Defined youthful face with a strong jawline, straight nose and expressive features
physical_design.hair: Black, slightly messy medium-length layered hair
physical_design.signature_mark: Small subtle sun-shaped birthmark near the upper chest

default_costume.upper: Dark charcoal jacket over a plain fitted black or deep grey T-shirt
default_costume.rule: Do not add royal armor, crowns or mythological clothing to Aarav during the early story.

power_visuals.manifestation: Protective golden energy forming geometric shield-like patterns around Aarav
power_visuals.eye_effect: A very subtle golden reflection may appear during activation
power_visuals.rule: Early manifestations must look unstable and incomplete rather than fully controlled.

voice_profile.delivery: Conversational during normal scenes, intense during emotional or action scenes
voice_profile.rule: Do not use an exaggerated superhero voice.

aarav.character_arc: A normal young man forced into an ancient supernatural conflict while searching for the truth behind his family's tragedy.

physical_design.face: Mature face with gentle but serious features
physical_design.hair: Short black hair with noticeable grey near the temples

default_costume.upper: Simple earth-toned shirt with a dark sleeveless jacket

vasu.continuity_rule: Vasu should visually communicate that he has lived an ordinary life while hiding an extraordinary secret.

physical_design.face: Kind mature face with expressive eyes
physical_design.hair: Long dark hair with a few subtle grey strands, usually tied back

default_costume.primary_outfit: Muted-color kurta with a light dupatta
default_costume.rule: Her design should feel grounded and realistic rather than royal or supernatural.

physical_design.hair: Long black hair, usually in a simple ponytail

default_costume.upper: Simple hoodie, jacket or casual top

voice_profile.delivery: Playful in normal scenes and emotionally intense during danger

physical_design.face: Sharp mature features with deep thoughtful eyes

default_costume.style: Traditional scholar blended with practical modern elements
default_costume.upper: Off-white kurta with a dark shawl
default_costume.accessories: Old rudraksha-style mala and a weathered leather satchel

voice_profile.language: Hindi with occasional Sanskrit terminology when contextually appropriate
voice_profile.delivery: Slow and deliberate without sounding theatrical

acharya_vedant.continuity_rule: Vedant must never behave as if he knows every answer. His knowledge is incomplete.

general_rahman.role: Senior figure connected to Unit Seven

physical_design.face: Strong mature face with a prominent jaw
physical_design.hair: Short dark hair with significant grey
physical_design.signature_feature: Small old scar above the right eyebrow

default_costume.upper: Dark tactical field jacket without obvious national military insignia
default_costume.rule: Unit Seven is fictional. Avoid real military unit insignia.

general_rahman.character_rule: Do not visually or narratively reveal whether Rahman is ultimately an ally or antagonist during the early episodes.

malik.identity_rule: His complete identity must remain hidden during the early story.

early_visual_design.clothing: Long dark contemporary coat with minimal details
early_visual_design.rule: Never accidentally reveal Malik's full face in early generated shots.

malik.story_rule: Do not reveal Malik's origin, complete powers or final objective until the planned story progression allows it.

relationship_rules.aarav_and_vasu: Strong father-son emotional bond with hidden secrets between them.
relationship_rules.aarav_and_yashoda: Deep maternal attachment and emotional safety.
relationship_rules.aarav_and_jaya: Playful but strongly protective family relationship.
relationship_rules.aarav_and_vedant: Initially distrustful mentor-student relationship that develops gradually.
relationship_rules.aarav_and_rahman: Uncertain relationship; Aarav cannot initially determine whether Rahman is helping or manipulating him.
relationship_rules.aarav_and_malik: Personal mystery and conflict connected to Aarav's family tragedy.

generation_rules.before_generating_visuals: Read the complete profile of every character appearing in the scene.
generation_rules.before_generating_dialogue: Read the personality and voice profile of the speaking character.
generation_rules.reference_images: Once approved character reference images exist, use them together with these descriptions.
generation_rules.continuity: Previously approved visual references override accidental visual variations produced by later generations.
generation_rules.no_random_changes: Never randomly change hairstyle, skin tone, facial structure, age appearance or body proportions.
generation_rules.costume_changes: Only change costumes when required by the story and preserve the character's physical identity.
